name: get_alarm
description: Get a CloudWatch alarm's current state, reason, metric, dimensions, threshold and recent state changes. Start every triage here.

name: get_metric_series
description: Get 1-minute datapoints for a CloudWatch metric over the last N minutes, plus min/max/median/last.

dimensions.description: Dimension name -> value, copy them from get_alarm

stat.description: Sum, Average, Maximum or a percentile like p99

name: query_logs
description: Run a CloudWatch Logs Insights query. With no query it returns the latest WARN/ERROR lines (level, msg, error, version, dependency).

name: get_recent_deploys
description: List the most recent published versions of a Lambda function and which version the live alias points to. Use it to check whether a deploy lines up with the incident start.

name: get_feature_flags
description: Read a service's feature flags and when they last changed.

name: score_anomaly
description: Score whether the latest values of a metric series are a real anomaly versus normal noise. Pass the metric values oldest to newest (at least 6).

name: search_past_incidents
description: Semantic search over past incident summaries and runbooks. Returns the closest matches with their incident IDs.

query.description: Describe the symptoms: alarm, error messages, what changed

name: create_incident_ticket
description: Open a ServiceNow incident. Call exactly once, after the diagnosis, with the evidence and suggested fix in the description.

name: notify_oncall
description: Post a short message to the on-call Slack channel. Call once, after the ticket exists, with the ticket number.
